AVG(x) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW).
SUM(x) OVER (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY t ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW).
ROWS counts physical rows. RANGE (the default with ORDER BY) treats rows with equal order values as one group.
GROUP BY returns one row per group. Window functions keep every row and add a computed column.
